sourceUI.addPlant: Pick a scene model for this paint set. The editor stays on its layer.
sourceUI.addSelected: Add the currently selected scene objects to this paint set.
sourceUI.selectFromScene: Choose one or more source models by name.
sourceUI.selectPlant: Select the highlighted source models in the scene.
sourceUI.removePlant: Unregister highlighted rows. To keep their settings, park models outside a source rectangle instead.
sourceUI.addPoint: Add a placeholder source that can later be replaced by a model.
sourceUI.addEmpty: Add a weighted empty source for intentional gaps in candidate-budget mode.
sourceUI.replacePoint: Replace one highlighted Point row with a scene model.
sourceUI.weightSpin: Relative source share within this paint set. Zero disables the source.
sourceUI.sourceZSpin: Offset instances of highlighted models along their placement normal.
sourceUI.sourceScaleSpin: Per-model scale multiplier. 1 keeps the model's original scale.
sourceUI.radiusSourceSpin: Collision footprint radius for highlighted source rows, in scene units.
sourceUI.followRadiusCheck: Scale this source's collision footprint with its instance scale.
sourceUI.showRadiusCheck: Show this source's radius in the viewport; does not change collision rules.
sourceUI.forwardAxis: The model's local forward direction, used for orientation.
sourceUI.existingGroups: Assign highlighted sources to an existing color group for clustering.
sourceUI.groupColor: Assign a color group to highlighted sources when the color is accepted.
sourceUI.applyColor: Assign the chosen color group to all highlighted source rows.

setsUI.addButton: Add another paint set sharing this layer's population and defaults.
setsUI.removeButton: Remove this paint set and its settings. The base set cannot be removed separately.
setsUI.nameEdit: Rename this paint set without changing its identity.
setsUI.weightSpin: Relative share of the layer population among enabled paint sets.
setsUI.enabledCheck: Include this set in calculation and final output.
setsUI.visibleCheck: Viewport visibility only. Hidden sets still calculate and affect spacing.
setsUI.upButton: Evaluate this set earlier. Earlier sets occupy space first.
setsUI.downButton: Evaluate this set later, after the preceding sets.

distributionUI.countSpin: Layer population before eligibility. Accepted target can retry up to its limits.
distributionUI.densitySpin: Requested plants per square metre of receiving surface; capped at 100,000.
distributionUI.seedSpin: Deterministic generation seed. Changing it can invalidate existing Edit bindings.
distributionUI.densityButton: Use UV channel 1: white permits candidates; black excludes them.
distributionUI.invertCheck: Reverse the density map's white and black eligibility.

populationPolicyUI.populationList: Budget evaluates the generated candidates; target makes bounded replacement attempts.
populationPolicyUI.attemptSpin: Maximum candidate attempts as a multiple of the requested population.
populationPolicyUI.roundSpin: Maximum rounds of eligibility, collision and cleanup. A shortfall can remain.
populationPolicyUI.repairCheck: Allow bounded retries for plants removed by final cleanup.

proceduralUI.scopeList: Choose within-set, between-set defaults, a set pair, or a layer pair.
proceduralUI.peerList: The other set or layer affected by this pair rule.
proceduralUI.enabledCheck: Enable only this collision scope. Other scopes are independent.
proceduralUI.multiplierSpin: Minimum distance = factor times (radius A + radius B), plus extra gap.
proceduralUI.gapSpin: Additional distance in scene units. Saves immediately; Manual waits for Update.
proceduralUI.planarCheck: Measure distance in world XY. Turn off to include height in 3D distance.
proceduralUI.resetRule: Remove a pair or self override, or reset the between-set default.

backgroundUI.backgroundList: Exclude earlier painted coverage, fill between plants, combine both, or turn off.
backgroundUI.applyBackground: Save this background mode and the selected earlier-set references together.

instanceRadiusUI.radiusMode: Use an absolute world radius or multiply the selected instances' source radius.
instanceRadiusUI.radiusSpin: Value applied only when Set selected radii is pressed.
instanceRadiusUI.applyRadius: Apply radius overrides to selected CS Edit instances in this paint set.
instanceRadiusUI.resetRadius: Restore the selected instances' inherited source radii.
instanceRadiusUI.clearRadius: Remove every instance-radius override belonging to this paint set.

spacingUI.collisionCheck: Layer default for self-spacing, used by sets without a self override.
spacingUI.radiusSpin: Inherited centre-distance rule uses two times this radius.
spacingUI.relaxCheck: Legacy point relaxation; paused under procedural evaluation or Brush coverage.
spacingUI.spacingSpin: Desired distance for legacy point relaxation.
spacingUI.iterationsSpin: Bound the number of legacy relaxation passes.
spacingUI.strengthSpin: Movement strength per legacy relaxation pass.

separationUI.cleanCheck: Remove isolated plants after collision across the whole logical layer.
separationUI.neighborSpin: Distance used to count nearby accepted plants during final cleanup.
separationUI.minNeighborSpin: Remove plants that have fewer than this many neighbors.
separationUI.minIslandSpin: Remove connected islands smaller than this number of plants.
separationUI.statsButton: Recalculate the setup, including spacing and cleanup.
separationUI.boundaryRelaxCheck: Legacy boundary relaxation; preserved but paused by shared spacing.

sourceContainersUI.modeList: Use a manual list or an explicit rectangle pool. Other paint sets may inherit the layer pool.
sourceContainersUI.createContainer: Create a Rectangle for this owner. Put source-model pivots inside its local XY bounds.
sourceContainersUI.pickContainer: Use an existing unmodified Rectangle as a source pool boundary.
sourceContainersUI.removeContainer: Unlink this rectangle without deleting it or registered source settings.

brushUI.coverageMode: Use the whole receiver or this paint set's saved painted coverage.
brushUI.radiusSpin: World-space radius of the next Brush stroke on the receiving surface.
brushUI.strengthSpin: Amount of coverage painted or erased by the next stroke.
brushUI.softSpin: Softness of the next stroke's edge.
brushUI.densitySpin: Thin plants allowed by the saved mask. Set absolute population on Population.
brushUI.beginButton: Paint this set on the shared surface. Creates an empty mask when needed.
brushUI.stopButton: Finish painting and retain the editable stroke history.
brushUI.fillButton: Fill coverage and reset stroke history. Undo restores the previous field.
brushUI.emptyButton: Empty coverage and reset stroke history. Undo restores the previous field.
brushUI.overlayMode: Coverage feedback only; it does not show which plants survive spacing.
brushUI.overlayColor: Viewport color for this paint set's coverage feedback.
brushUI.strokeEnabled: Enable or disable the highlighted saved stroke without deleting it.
brushUI.strokeErase: Change the highlighted saved stroke between paint and erase.
brushUI.strokeRadius: Change the radius of the highlighted saved stroke.
brushUI.strokeStrength: Change the strength of the highlighted saved stroke.
brushUI.strokeSoft: Change the edge softness of the highlighted saved stroke.
brushUI.deleteStroke: Delete the highlighted stroke. Undo restores it.
brushUI.resetTarget: Confirm before replacing this set's paint with an empty mask on the current receiver.

areaUI.pickArea: Pick a closed shape as an include/exclude Area shared by all sets in this layer.
areaUI.addAreaScene: Choose closed Area shapes by name.
areaUI.removeArea: Unlink highlighted Areas and their falloff settings; keep the scene shapes.
areaUI.refreshAreas: Refresh Area geometry and recalculate the layer preview.
areaUI.aaPick: Choose an existing Cyrus Surface Analyzer for line or point masks.
areaUI.aaRemove: Disable and unlink the layer's Analyzer Area mask.
areaUI.aaLine: Use the Analyzer centre line as an XY mask; unions with its point mask.
areaUI.aaWidth: Full width of the Analyzer centre-line Area mask.
areaUI.aaCaps: Flat or round ends for the line mask.
areaUI.aaStreetOffset: Lateral offset from the Analyzer centre line.
areaUI.aaPoints: Use discs around Analyzer points as an XY mask.
areaUI.aaRadius: Radius of each Analyzer point mask.
areaUI.fallTarget: Edit Analyzer boundary falloff or one highlighted Area's independent falloff.
areaUI.fallPick: Choose the Analyzer whose boundary drives this falloff.
areaUI.fallRemove: Unlink the falloff Analyzer and disable its falloff effects.
areaUI.fallDeleteCheck: Exclude an edge band before scale and density ramps begin.
areaUI.fallDeleteSpin: Width of the excluded edge band in scene units.
areaUI.fallScaleCheck: Vary instance scale with distance from this boundary.
areaUI.fallScaleSpin: Distance over which the scale curve is evaluated.
areaUI.fallDensityCheck: Vary candidate eligibility with distance from this boundary.
areaUI.fallDensitySpin: Distance over which the density curve is evaluated.

randomUI.projectCheck: Project random movement back onto the receiving surface.
randomUI.alignCheck: Align instances to the receiving surface normal.
randomUI.resetRotation: Reset only this layer's random rotation limits. Undo is available.
randomUI.resetScale: Reset only this layer's separate X, Y and Z scale limits.
randomUI.resetWholeScale: Reset only this layer's uniform scale multiplier.
randomUI.resetMovement: Reset only this layer's random translation limits.

diversityUI.divSeedSpin: Change source assignment randomness without changing the generation seed.
diversityUI.pickAnalyzer: Choose an existing Surface Analyzer for the legacy assignment modes.
diversityUI.pickPath: Pick a spline for Line Pattern assignment.
diversityUI.removePath: Remove the selected assignment path while keeping the scene spline.
diversityUI.addOutside: Add a source-assignment band outside the selected path.
diversityUI.addInside: Add a source-assignment band inside the selected path.
diversityUI.removeStrokeButton: Remove the selected assignment band and its settings.
diversityUI.refreshGroups: Refresh available source color groups for assignment.

detailsUI.refreshButton: Read the existing calculation statistics without regenerating placements.
detailsUI.helpButton: Explain settings ownership, display budgets, evaluation order and policy limits.
